observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same PS5 game case for EA Sports FC26.
The case is blue, typical of PS5 physical game cases.
The cover art features two football players, one in a Real Madrid kit and one in a Bayern Munich kit.
The top of the case clearly shows 'PS5' logo.
The game title 'FC26' is prominently displayed.
The PEGI 3 rating is visible in the bottom left corner.
There is a green circular sticker on the right side of the cover, possibly a certification or promotional label.

The photos are taken from a top-down angle on a dark surface.
